attchmntText: Goenka Diamond and Jewels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Goenka Diamond and Jewels Limited approved the un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The board meeting took place on November 14, 2026, starting at 02:00 P.M. and concluding at 04:00 P.M. The approval includes the limited review report for the specified period. The company has enclosed the approved financial results and the limited review report with this announcement.

attchmntText: Goenka Diamond and Jewels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
